Name: justoneapi-xiaohongshu-pgy
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is a legitimate API wrapper for Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) analytics provided by JustOneAPI. The execution script `bin/run.mjs` is a straightforward Node.js utility that performs authenticated GET requests to `api.justoneapi.com` based on the operations defined in `generated/operations.json`. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection in `SKILL.md`.

llm.guidance: This skill is a generated Node client for JustOneAPI and appears coherent: it will run the included bin/run.mjs script and make GET requests to api.justoneapi.com using JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN. Before installing, consider: (1) only provide a JustOneAPI token with minimal necessary scope and keep it secret; (2) review bin/run.mjs yourself (or inspect its full contents) to confirm it doesn't log or transmit the token to other endpoints; (3) if you have organizational security controls, restrict the token or use a scoped/testing token first; (4) monitor network requests while first using the skill and revoke the token if anything unexpected occurs.
